title: Details behind Broncos guard Ben Powers restructured contract

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Details behind Broncos guard Ben Powers restructured contract
sources.description: Last week, it was reported that starting left guard Ben Powers accepted a pay cut from the Denver Broncos. 9NEWS Denver’s Mike Klis reported that Powers accepted a restructured one-year deal that will leave him with less pay but a higher guarantee. Well, now we have the details of that restructured deal for Ben Powers. […]
